title: Module quiz: Batch processing and multi-pass review

blocks.text: Questions on what this page has just taught. Choose one answer for each.

questions.stem: Scenario S5, Claude Code in CI. A weekly audit submits per-file entries as one batch. When it ends, an integration pass over those results is submitted as a second batch. Each batch finishes within 24 hours, and handling takes 1 hour after each. What is the longest the audit can take, in hours?

options.says: Ruled out because "it cannot be in the same batch as them", so the audit is not one window.
Ruled out because the worst case is "two processing windows plus the handling after each", and 48 has no handling.
The integration pass reads the first batch's results, so the two windows run one after the other, with the handling after each: 24 + 1 + 24 + 1.
Ruled out for the same sentence, since the handling is "plus the handling after each" batch and not once.

origin.section: Local passes and an integration pass

questions.stem: Scenario S6, structured data extraction. A team will extract fields from 400,000 archived documents through a batch. A trial on 100 easy documents shows no failures. What should happen before the full submission?

options.text: Submit everything and repair the prompt from whatever fails
options.says: Ruled out because "a day passes before the failures show, and the whole run is repeated".

options.text: Run a varied sample synchronously and refine the prompt on it
options.says: A prompt is proven on a sample that includes the awkward documents, run synchronously so the answer comes at once, before the discount is spent on volume.

options.text: Repeat the trial on another hundred easy ones and then submit
options.says: Ruled out because "a sample of easy documents proves nothing".

options.text: Run a varied sample through the batch queue and refine the prompt on it
options.says: Ruled out because the advice is to "run the prompt synchronously on a small, varied sample", and a trial in the queue waits a window for each result.

questions.stem: Scenario S2, code generation with Claude Code. Two independent review passes report the same injection risk. One rates it 1 on a severity scale of 1 to 3 with confidence 95, and the other rates it 3 with confidence 70. Which entry does the combined list carry?

options.says: Ruled out because the rule is "Take the highest severity any pass gave", and nothing is averaged.
Ruled out because the rule is "so that a pass that saw the danger is not overruled by one that missed it".
Ruled out because the rule is "the lowest confidence, so that the weakest evidence caps the claim".
The entry keeps the highest severity and the lowest confidence.
